sources.corpus: Local disc UCJS10117; work/source/corpus.json. Source IDs are stable archive/member/section/row coordinates.

policies.romanization: ASCII Hepburn without macrons: Itsuka, Kitsuto, Genta, Orin, Shutendoji, Hiruko, Taishoten, Mount Oe. Names have project status until reviewed.
policies.honorifics: Itsuka addresses the variable clan head as %$ with respectful phrasing; avoid gendered titles because the player chooses gender.
policies.controls: Preserve every bracketed control tag, percent placeholder, leading @ marker and original line-break count. Their engine behavior and expanded widths need in-game verification.
policies.catchphrase: Adapt Itsuka's emphatic catchphrase to the sentence (with a bang / go all out / wholeheartedly); do not turn every occurrence into the same unnatural English phrase.
policies.voice: Itsuka: bright, conversational, earnest, gently cheeky. Kitsuto: playful with a sharp edge.
policies.gender: Use only documented gender, never infer it from a name. Runtime clan members remain gender-neutral unless the scene specifies otherwise.
policies.fit: Draft full meaning first. Original byte length is diagnostic, not a translation budget; relocation and measured text-box fit are pending.
